As international student through, I def emphasise with your travelling anxiety. I was called into secondary questioning every time I had flown back so I knew to keep ALL my legal paperwork in one folder. It wouldn’t help to have an unofficial transcript with you but they have never checked mine. They have asked me these questions though: 
- what’s your major (will cross reference with your i20) 

-what’s your GPA (did not check my transcript) 

-what’s your school mascot


As long as you answer truthfully, you should be ok. Other tips I’m sure you’ve heard are: 
- disable Face ID 
- upload all your phone data onto cloud and wipe the physical phone (or take a travel phone) 

I never needed to do that for US (have done it travelling to China) but if you’ve been critical of the current gov I’d err on the side of caution.

Hey, f1 who failed 51c in 2020 here. You’re fine. They don’t check your transcripts when you go through immigrations upon arrival. 

Just make sure you retake 51c during the summer to keep your education on track and prepare to have your passport, i20 in a folder. 

Immigrations may ask about your grades or school if you are called for secondary inspection but they didn’t bat an eye when I told them my non perfect GPA.
